urlText: Buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland
content:
Saturday 7 to Monday 9 June
  • Buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland.
  • Trains run between Waterfall, Sutherland and Bondi Junction, some to a changed timetable.

  • Sunday from 5.45am to 8am, trains run between Waterfall or Sutherland and the City Circle, and between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Change trains at Central or Town Hall to continue your journey.
  • Trains make extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

urlText: Ferries will be busy during Vivid Sydney
content:
Ferry passengers are advised to expect delays and long queues for ferries to and from the city during Vivid Sydney from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June.
  • Services will be busy and are expected to reach capacity from mid-afternoon, particularly on weekends.
  • Some additional F3 and F4 ferries will run on weeknights and weekends during the event.
  • Vivid Sydney attendees planning to catch a ferry to precincts around Circular Quay, Barangaroo or Pyrmont should plan ahead and have a back-up transport option in mind, from most wharves you can catch buses to the city or to nearby train stations to connect with services to the city.
  • Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event.

Sydney Metro West construction work at Burwood will permanently close the following bus stops:
 
From 4am Monday, 4 April 2022
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 461X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd at Esher Lane (213431).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 416X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd before Parramatta Rd (213462).

From 6am Monday 4 April 2022:
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 services should use the new stop on Parramatta Rd, after Burwood Rd (213460).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 towards City Town Hall should use the alternate stop on Parramatta Rd opp Neichs Pde (213721).

urlText: Buses replace trains between Lithgow and Mount Victoria
content:
Monday 26 to Friday 30 May
  • Buses replace trains between Lithgow and Mount Victoria.
  • Trains run between Mount Victoria and Central, some to a changed timetable.
  • Bathurst trains run to a changed timetable between Bathurst and Lithgow or Central.

  • Friday from 8.50pm, buses replace trains from Lithgow to Blacktown.
  • The last train to Central leaves Mount Victoria at 19:56, arriving Central at 22:17.
  • From 10.40pm, buses replace trains from Blacktown to Lithgow.
  • The last train to the Blue Mountains leaves Central at 21:09, arriving Mount Victoria 23:33.
  • T1 trains run between the City and St Marys, to a changed timetable. Change at Blacktown for buses to Blue Mountains Line stations.

  • If you are travelling to Lithgow to connect with NSW TrainLink Regional Coaches, please call 132 232 to confirm departure times.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

urlText: L2 and L3 partial line closures during Vivid Sydney on Fridays and weekends
content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June, L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services will be partially closed on Friday nights and weekends.
  • L2 and L3 light rail services will not run between Town Hall and Circular Quay due to road closures and for pedestrian safety on the following days and times:
    • Fridays from 6pm to 1am
    • Weekends from 5pm to 1am (Saturdays, Sundays and public holiday Mon 9 Jun)

  • Light rail services will continue to run between Town Hall and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford during these times. L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will run as per normal during Vivid Sydney from 5am to 1am daily.
  • If you’re travelling to Circular Quay, continue on foot from Town Hall or change for trains.
  • Note on Saturdays and on Sunday 8 June from 6pm to 11pm, Sydney Trains services will not drop off passengers at Circular Quay Station – use Wynyard, Martin Place or St James stations instead.
  • Allow extra travel time as services will be very busy. Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event.
subtitle: L2 and L3 partial line closures during Vivid Sydney on Fridays and weekends

content:
Road closures will be in place on sections of O’Connell St, Ross St and Victoria Rd on Friday 23 May for the NRL match at CommBank Stadium. 
  
The following bus stops will be closed and routes 546, 549, 550, 600, 601 and 606 will be diverting while the road closures are in place between approximately 9.45pm to 10.15pm.   
  
Walk to nearby alternative stops, see the road closure and transport map for more details: 
  • Parramatta Leagues Club, O'Connell Street will be closed – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills and North West)  
  • Our Lady of Mercy College, O'Connell Street will be closed – alternative stop O’Connell Street at Fennell Street (for services towards Parramatta Station)  
  • Victoria Road after Villiers Street will be closed – alternative stop All Saints Anglican Church, Victoria Road (for services towards Parramatta Station)  
  • Victoria Road before Marist Place will be closed – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills, Epping and Macquarie Park)    
Check signs at stops and see the event page for more info.

urlText: Circular Quay service changes during Vivid Sydney
content:
On Saturday nights and on Sunday of the long weekend (8 June) during Vivid Sydney from 23 May to 14 June, trains will not drop off passengers at Circular Quay Station from 6pm to 11pm due to large crowds expected in the precinct.
  • Use Wynyard, Martin Place or St James stations instead on these nights and continue on foot towards Circular Quay.
  • Trains will continue to pick up passengers from Circular Quay during these times.
  • Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event.

urlText: Changes to Bega Valley bus services from 12 May 2025
content:
From Monday 12 May 2025
 
Sapphire Coast Buslines timetable and route changes will improve travel for Bega Valley communities.
 
What's changing:
  • More services on routes 890 and 891, with reduced gaps between trips.
  • Route 892 has been withdrawn. Passengers should now use routes 890 or 891 instead.
  • Some route 885 (Tathra to Kalaru) services will now start or end at Kalaru. Passengers travelling between Tathra and Bega may need to transfer at Kalaru to route 891.
  • All route 886 (Tathra to Kalaru) services now start and end at Kalaru. Passengers travelling between Tathra and Merimbula will need to transfer at Kalaru to route 891.
See the news story for more details.
 
Plan your trip and check timetables at transportnsw.info/trip.

urlText: Erskine St/King Street Wharf diversions during Vivid Sydney
content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June, route 288, 290 and 292 buses will be using different stops due to road closures and expected heavy traffic.
  • From 5pm to 1am on Saturdays and Sunday of the long weekend (8 June) buses will start and end trips at Wynyard instead of Sussex St near King St Wharf.
  • Buses to the city will end trips at Wynyard Station York Street Stand P (200048). Buses leaving the city will start trips from Wynyard Station Clarence Street Stand R near Margaret St (2000142). 
  • Continue on foot from Wynyard via the underground Wynyard Walk to reach the King St Wharf or Barangaroo precincts. Allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for the alternative stop locations.
  • Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more transport details.

urlText: L2 and L3 light rail services may be temporarily held at stops or partially closed due to a Police Operation
content:
Saturday 24 May
  • L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services may be impacted between 1.30pm and 3.30pm approximately due to road closures around Town Hall for two planned Police Operation protest marches: 
    • L2 and L3 services may be temporarily held at stops, or 
    • L2 and L3 services may be temporarily partially closed between Town Hall and Circular Quay.
  • Impact to services and timings may change at the direction of NSW Police.
  • Please check information screens at stops, listen to announcements and follow the direction of staff or Police on site, as necessary.
  • Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner for alternative transport options, including trains, buses or walking.
  • L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services should continue to run as per normal.
